teamMembers.name: Prof. Indika Perera
teamMembers.title: DIRECTOR, HUMAN AI LAB
teamMembers.bio: Prof. Indika Perera has over 25 years of research experience in distributed systems and intelligent software architectures. He spearheaded the creation of Human AI Lab to unite machine learning models with human behavioral sciences. He previously worked as an advisor to the Ministry of Technology on state-level infrastructure digitization and currently chairs the University's AI Task Force.
teamMembers.expertise: Expertise in Multi-Agent Systems and Cognitive Architecture.

teamMembers.name: Dr. Alex Chen
teamMembers.title: LEAD RESEARCHER
teamMembers.bio: Dr. Alex Chen completed her PhD at Oxford University focusing on the socio-technical impacts of algorithmic automation in developing economies. She serves on international AI policy panels and actively collaborates with civic tech groups to draft human-centered AI legislation. Her research focuses on the intersection of data ethics, post-colonial geography, and public policy.
teamMembers.expertise: Specializing in AI Ethics and Policy in the Global South.

teamMembers.name: Dr. Jordan Taylor
teamMembers.title: PRINCIPAL INVESTIGATOR
teamMembers.bio: Dr. Jordan Taylor leads the Robotics and Human-Machine Interface labs at the University of Moratuwa. His research concentrates on developing low-cost, lightweight sensors and physical actuators that enable safer, more collaborative interactions between elders, field workers, and autonomous machinery. He is a passionate advocate for physical-first interface designs.
teamMembers.expertise: Pioneering work in Affective Computing and User Experience.

teamMembers.name: Prof. Emeritus Morgan Smith
teamMembers.title: SENIOR ADVISOR
teamMembers.bio: Prof. Morgan Smith is a pioneer of computer science in Sri Lanka, having introduced the country's first software engineering curricula in the 1980s. His current advisory focus is on archiving and preserving local linguistic histories and cultural databases using decentralized technologies, ensuring future generations have clean, representative datasets to train localized systems.
teamMembers.expertise: Foundational contributor to AI research in Sri Lanka.

foundingRAs.name: Samuel Green
foundingRAs.title: Founding RA
foundingRAs.bio: Samuel is a graduate from the Department of Computer Science & Engineering. His research focuses on deploying low-latency deep learning models on edge computing devices in collaborative workspaces.

foundingRAs.name: Emily Brooks
foundingRAs.title: Founding RA
foundingRAs.bio: Emily specializes in user experience design and human-robot interaction loops. She investigates how tactile interfaces and physical affordances affect user trust during robotics operations in healthcare settings.

foundingRAs.name: David Kim
foundingRAs.title: Founding RA
foundingRAs.bio: David holds an engineering degree and works on reinforcement learning algorithms for autonomous path planning. He designs decentralized coordination protocols for multi-agent robotic fleets.

foundingRAs.name: Olivia Parker
foundingRAs.title: Founding RA
foundingRAs.bio: Olivia translates high-level ethical guidelines into actionable software constraints. She develops automated compliance checkers for municipal planning systems and low-resource natural language processors.
